import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_44/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_44/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform join on 'city' column (inner join by default)
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city")

# Group by 'city' and aggregate:
# - average of Source2_44_0.fare (float)
# - max of Source2_44_0.ride_id (integer)
agg_df = df_joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({
    "fare": "mean",
    "ride_id": "max"
})

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema
agg_df["city"] = agg_df["city"].astype(str)
agg_df["fare"] = agg_df["fare"].astype(float)
agg_df["ride_id"] = agg_df["ride_id"].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_44/target_multisource.csv"
agg_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_44/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_44/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city' column (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'city' (the primary key), aggregate fare by average, ride_id by max
result = joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({
    "fare": "mean",
    "ride_id": "max"
})

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target schema
result = result[["city", "fare", "ride_id"]]

# Write output to the specified file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_44/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
